episodes.title: Happy Wedding Eve
episodes.summary: Wedding guests arrive on Nantucket for the lavish rehearsal dinner at the Winbury estate, but the nuptials take a tragic turn when a body is discovered.

episodes.title: She Would Never Do That
episodes.summary: While police search Summerland for clues, Greer's swift attempt to control the narrative makes Amelia uneasy. A wedding guest tries to leave the island.

episodes.title: The Perfect Family
episodes.summary: Greer works to keep up appearances for a magazine interview. Abby shares a scandalous secret. Amelia says the quiet part out loud during a family dinner.

episodes.title: Someone Could Get Hurt
episodes.summary: Tough questions from Detective Henry deepen Amelia's suspicions. Greer receives a mysterious call. Tensions rise and tempers flare among the Winburys.

episodes.title: Never Gonna Give You Up
episodes.summary: As Tag's movements at the party come under scrutiny, Amelia asks some questions of her own. Greer's efforts to throw the perfect book launch go awry.

episodes.title: That Feels Better
episodes.summary: A twist in the police investigation plunges the Winbury family further into crisis. As long-buried secrets emerge, so does the truth about what happened.
